--- create_search_index_order_by_interleave.sql
CREATE SEARCH INDEX AlbumsIndex
ON Albums(AlbumTitle_Tokens)
PARTITION BY SingerId
ORDER BY ReleaseTimestamp DESC
, INTERLEAVE IN Singers
OPTIONS(sort_order_sharding=true)
--- AST

  Name: &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{

        NameEnd: 31,
        Name:    "AlbumsIndex",
      },
    },
  },
  TableName: &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{

        NamePos: 35,
        NameEnd: 41,
        Name:    "Albums",
      },
    },
  },
  TokenListPart: []*ast.Ident{
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 42,
      NameEnd: 59,
      Name:    "AlbumTitle_Tokens",

      NameEnd: 82,
      Name:    "SingerId",
    },

  OrderBy: &ast.OrderBy{
    Order: 83,

      &ast.OrderByItem{

      },
    },
  },
  Interleave: &ast.InterleaveIn{
    Comma:     114,
    TableName: &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 130,
      NameEnd: 137,
      Name:    "Singers",
    },
  },
  Options: &ast.Options{
    Options: 138,
    Rparen:  170,
    Records: []*ast.OptionsDef{
      &ast.OptionsDef{
        Name: &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 146,
          NameEnd: 165,
          Name:    "sort_order_sharding",
        },
        Value: &ast.BoolLiteral{
          ValuePos: 166,
          Value:    true,
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
CREATE SEARCH INDEX AlbumsIndex ON Albums(AlbumTitle_Tokens) PARTITION BY SingerId ORDER BY ReleaseTimestamp DESC, INTERLEAVE IN Singers OPTIONS (sort_order_sharding = true)
